From Ozon Baby · Price: it only works through holes or openings (a door, a vent, a wound).

Theme Force and Energy

  • 1: 1 action: change air pressure through an opening within 30 ft; creatures in a 10-ft area behind it are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 1} (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates).
  • 5: Surge: pressure blast through an opening: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[bludgeoning]] (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}) to creatures in a 10-ft area.
  • 9: Pressure can seal a door for 1 minute; opening it takes an @Check[athletics|against:stand] check against your stand DC.
  • 13: Through a wound: target your stand damaged this round, @Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 1} for 1 round.
  • 17: The area is 20 ft.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
